description: Atlas Insurance Limited is a general insurance company incorporated on 6 September 1934 and one of the oldest insurers in Pakistan; it was founded by Dr. Sir Muhammad Iqbal and has been part of the Atlas Group since 1980. It is a subsidiary of Shirazi Investments (Private) Limited and writes conventional general insurance across fire, marine, motor, health, engineering and crop risks, adding Shariah-compliant cover through Window Takaful Operations licensed by the SECP in March 2016. PACRA rates its insurer financial strength AA+ with a stable outlook.
headOffice: 63/A, Block XX, Phase III (Commercial), Defence Housing Authority, Lahore, Pakistan
